answer: Bonded vouch bridge: each agent locks a stake and unique hardware key; a new key needs vouches from bonded peers. The registry samples a public random seed (the walnut nonce) to audit vouchers, checking collateral and pushing failed vouchers down a reputation ledge. Sybil creation costs the attacker a burned identity bond, lost vouches, and audit slashing, so mass fake identities become economically unprofitable.
